metadata.chapter: Chapter 23 - CABLE FRANCHISE APPLICATION AND PROCESS

content.title: Chapter 23 - CABLE FRANCHISE APPLICATION AND PROCESS — Sec. 23-40. - Public hearing.
content.summary:
Arvada shall hold a public hearing before acting on the application, affording participants
               a process substantially equivalent to that required by 47 U.S.C. section 546(c)(2)
               governing renewal of cable franchises.
(
Ord. No. 4078, § 1, 7-16-07
)
